value.title: Workstream 004 closed: what worked, what to do differently

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Outcome: the Copilot cache proxy shipped in one day. PRs #238 (docs), #239 (s02 sidecar), #241 (s03 daemon gate), #242 (s04 receipts), #243 (s05 F204+F205) and #244 (close-out). All 14 PRD 004 rows are shipped. s06 (proof follow-ups) is planned.
What worked:
- A spike by the specialist (takin, model-cost) before the PRD settled the token question (gho_, no expiry, refresh only on a 401) and the quota gate (copilot_internal/user, not a model probe). The prime then ruled sidecar vs in-daemon from evidence.
- Two lanes in parallel against a contract written in the blueprint (the c-status-route JSON). The coders' type clarifications were relayed by pm-004 between lanes.
- Fold findings that arrive between rounds into the pending push, so round counts stay at 2.
- Live acceptance on prod found two bugs that every lane review missed: F204 (the status route awaited upstream GETs, so a 1 s probe raised a false outage) and F205 (a stale 402 latched after an account switch). Budget a fix lane (s05) after acceptance.
Do differently:
- Write requirement states only from evidence: #241 marked req-01/req-09 shipped before s04 proved them (F241-002).
- A rebase onto a moving main means the reviewers need range-diff instructions; send them with the new head.
- Docs PRs need a reviewer verdict too (prime ruling); docs-only skips only performance.
- Live windows on a shared sidecar: get the prime's go per window, send FYIs to other primes at start and end, and make sure it ends ON and ready.
- Unquoted heredocs in pij send run backticks in the shell: use the pij_send tool or quoted heredocs.
- Close seats with the F194 procedure (see the earlier note); pij close never completed for role-holding seats today.
